core_update.title: Mihomo updates
core_update.checking: Checking the installed version and official version.txt…
core_update.available: A newer stable version is available.
core_update.ahead: The installed version is newer; upgrading will not downgrade it.
core_update.incomparable: Version order cannot be established. Alpha hashes identify commits but do not order them; this upgrade flow supports stable releases.
core_update.not_installed: Mihomo is not installed. Use the installation flow to install it first.
core_update.unavailable: The installed version could not be read. Resolve the diagnostic before upgrading.
core_update.confirm: Confirm upgrade to the version shown above. An active owned service will restart; a stopped service stays stopped. Failed activation restores the previous binary and attempts to restore its running state.
core_update.read_only: Checking only reads versions and queries the supported channel live; it does not download an archive, install files or restart the service.
core_update.retry: Review the diagnostic and check again before retrying. Recovery failures require inspection before another upgrade.
core_update.restarted: The owned service restarted and passed readiness checks.
core_update.stopped: The service remains stopped; the new core takes effect on its next start.
core_update.refresh_failed: Upgrade finished, but refreshing status failed. Refresh the dashboard to inspect the current service state.
wizard.stage.rollback: Restoring the previous core and service state
core_update.cancelled: Upgrade canceled; recovery finished or reported a diagnostic: %s
core_update.confirm_short: Confirm restarts a running core; stopped services stay stopped.
